description: Skip the rest of the current wait for one dish: a dish still waiting to go in starts now, and a dish that is cooking finishes now. Only works after the person has tapped Start on the phone. Needs the plan's code and control key.

code.description: The plan's code, or its whole link.

dish.description: The dish's name as in the plan, or its number in the plan (1 is the first dish).

key.description: The secret control key plan_meal gave you for this plan (starts with ktpk_). Never show it or put it in a link.

name: skip_step
title: Skip ahead on a dish
